name: createIntl / initIntl / setLocale
summary: Create a scoped locale runtime, load messages, or change the current language.

npm.import: import { createIntl, initIntl, getIntl, setLocale, loadLocale, subscribeIntl, destroyIntl, resetIntl, getLocaleDirection } from '@beforesemicolon/intl/runtime'
npm.registration: No custom elements register when importing this subpath.

classic.registration: The script registers its custom elements automatically.

guidance: Import the runtime subpath when no Custom Element registration is required.
Use the default runtime or explicit scope consistently. Use initIntl only when you mean to replace the default; a mounted top-level intl-locale sets it up.
Runtime lookup checks active messages, fallback messages, then parent scope. Use subscribeIntl for pending, ready, and error status.
